description: Source code for a web scraper class 'RutgerBakt' that extracts recipe information from 'rutgerbakt.nl'. It defines methods for retrieving author, title, category, yields, ingredient groups, instructions, and description, utilizing HTML parsing and external utility functions.

classes.name: RutgerBakt
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from rutgerbakt.nl, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name 'Rutger van den Broek'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves and cleans the recipe title from the schema.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Extracts the recipe category from the footer div if available.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns None as yields are inconsistent.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Uses external 'group_ingredients' to parse ingredient groups from the HTML.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Finds the instructions section by filtering headings and parsing subsequent elements.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the first paragraph text as the recipe description.
